# E0608: effect that the manifest doesn't grant

A dependency performs only the effects and capabilities that its entry grants with `may`, as `may = ["fs"]`, and `unsafe` code only with `unsafe`. Grant what it needs, if you trust it with that.

- Rule: [`packages.ungranted-effects`](../../reference/04-programs.md#packages.ungranted-effects)
- Reported at: the entry's key, in the manifest that holds it.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0608_capability_not_granted`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0608_capability_not_granted):

`deps/logs/src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
use std.fs

pub fn log(msg: str) / io {
  if !fs.exists("quiet") { print(msg) }
}
```

`deps/logs/stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "logs"
```

`src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
use logs

fn main() / io { logs.log("started") }
```

`stilt.toml`:

```text
[package]
name = "app"

[dependencies]
logs = { path = "deps/logs", may = ["console"] }
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── EFFECT THAT THE MANIFEST DOESN'T GRANT ────────────── stilt.toml:5:1  [E0608]

`logs.log` uses `fs`, by calling `fs.exists` at deps/logs/src/main.lt:4:7, but
this manifest doesn't grant `fs` to `logs`:

  5 │ logs = { path = "deps/logs", may = ["console"] }
    │ ^^^^

A dependency performs only the effects and capabilities that its entry grants
with `may`, as `may = ["fs"]`, and `unsafe` code only with `unsafe`. Grant what
it needs, if you trust it with that.

To fix it, grant `fs` and `console` to `logs`:

  5 │ logs = { path = "deps/logs", may = ["fs", "console"] }
    │                                    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```

The program [`E0608_unsafe_not_granted`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0608_unsafe_not_granted):

`deps/zip/src/main.lt`:

```stilt fragment
use std.c

extern fn crc32(crc: u64, buf: c.Ptr<u8>, len: u32) -> u64

pub fn checksum(data: List<u8>) -> u64 {
  let len = data.len().wrap_to_u32()
  unsafe because "crc32 reads len bytes from buf, which with_ptr keeps alive for the call" {
    data.with_ptr(|p| crc32(0, p, len))
  }
}
```
